title: stories.json
description: User stories compiled from PRD.md by tools/gen_stories.py (contract C1). Title, acceptance and covers come from the PRD; status, surfaces, devices, waits_on, notes, evidence and qa are preserved across regenerations. Readers ignore unknown keys.

id.description: Stable story id, e.g. US-01. Never reused.

acceptance.description: Numbered acceptance criteria from the PRD, in order. Criterion n is referenced as US-01.n.

surfaces.description: Routes or screens the story is visible on, e.g. /login.

devices.description: Device profiles the story must pass on, e.g. phone-390x844, tablet-820x1180, desktop-1440x900, ios-sim, android-emu.

status.description: NOT_BUILT: no code. BUILT: code exists, not verified. PARTIAL: a gate failed or was inconclusive for this story (name it in notes). LIVE: every gate passed on a committed SHA; set it with gen_stories.py --set, which records commit:<sha> in evidence. PARKED: deliberately not now (cite the D-id in notes).

waits_on.description: Story ids, task ids, requirement ids or decision ids that must be done first.

covers.description: Requirement ids (R-01) this story covers, from the (R-01) after the PRD heading.

evidence.description: Verifier report paths (.qa/verify/US-01.md), done-gate reports, PR links, and commit:<sha> for LIVE.

qa.description: Optional, for foundry-qa persona_run.py. Without it, start = surfaces[0] when that is a path, and the agent judges the acceptance criteria.
